rows.reply: Aarav, real box ko ghumakar dekho—front ke opposite bhi face hota hai; ab total faces count karo. Ek band cuboid snack box ki photo mein top, front aur right faces dikh rahe hain. Poore box ke kitne faces hain?

rows.said: Mujhe lagta hai 6 faces.
rows.heard: मुझे लगता है छह faces.
rows.reply: Bilkul Aarav, tumne cuboid ke chhe alag faces count kiye. Chalo sticks aur clay ki goliyon se cube ka dhaancha banate hain. Sticks edges hain aur goliyan corners. Kitni sticks aur kitni goliyan chahiye?

rows.said: Bas aise hi pata tha.
rows.heard: बस ऐसे ही पता था।
rows.reply: Aarav, cube ka dhaancha banate waqt har edge ko ek stick aur har milne wali jagah ko ek clay ball socho. Sticks edges hain aur goliyan corners. Kitni sticks aur kitni goliyan chahiye?

rows.said: Baarah sticks and aath clay balls.
rows.heard: बारह sticks and eight clay balls.
rows.reply: Aarav, tumne cube ke 12 edges aur 8 corners bilkul sahi count kiye. Square pyramid mein corners kitne honge?

rows.heard: तो दब्बे की फ्लैट साइड को फेस कहते हैं।
rows.reply: Upar wale point ko corner bhi ginna. Museum roof ka model square pyramid hai: neeche ek square base aur upar ek point par milne wali chaar triangular sides hain. Iske total faces aur corners kitne hain? Dono counts batao.
